review.description: Host subscriptions/challenge/delivery/filtering/refresh/unsubscribe behavior remains unchanged. New plugin/review operation records emit ordinary local journal events; those records are not a delivered host notification and do not close callback acceptance.
review.implementation: Verified no events-service or callback transport implementation changed. Admin UI reads operation state through the MCP Apps bridge, and automatic review is triggered by successful provider polling under owner policy rather than by an invented host callback.
review.tests: Existing subscription verification/retry/dedup/expiry and callback safety tests rerun in fixture mode. Plugin status and review-trigger tests establish only local persisted observations and work, preserving the actual-host callback and subscription gaps.
